answer: Payout leaves the epoch as a claim that vests over many epochs and releases only as later work lands. Sample a random slice of submissions each epoch and re-run it; one failed re-run cancels the claim. That flips the economics of cloning, because the attacker cannot withdraw, only accumulate claims that need honest output to ripen. A meadow of clones on one knoll ends up holding paper it never redeems, and one gale of bad samples clears the ledger.
